prior_context: R2 registered PASS with dense-measurement caveat remains unchanged. Further hidden-loss weights/midpoints are not searched.
external_corpus_status: UD source metadata located, but full files could not be acquired into this runtime. GitHub mutation endpoints returned Resource not found twice after rediscovery. This trial is NOT independent-corpus validation.

H.main: The TEN starting-state advantage remains after 250 English updates even when only the English output head is trainable.
H.mechanistic_scope: A positive head-only result demonstrates usable frozen features in this setup; it does not prove semantics or exclude optimization-dependent transfer in other setups.

T.model: Unchanged archived 141056-parameter two-layer byte Transformer, d64, ctx128, batch16, AdamW lr0.001 wd0 clip1.
T.stream: Identical historical English minibatches per seed/step across all six branches. Only trainable parameter set changes; new AdamW each branch.
T.readouts: Shared learned head for English and Japanese. Separately evaluate Japanese using the same-condition phase1 head (explicit language routing, extra 16384 parameters). No head interpolation or refitting.
T.metrics: Fixed update endpoints 0,1,5,10,25,50,100,150,200,250; no hitting-time interpolation. All unique exact-line-clean eval documents, no cross-document context, score byte positions1..end once in 128-position blocks.

D.main_exploratory_gate: All audits valid; HEAD_ONLY EN_final250(TEN)-EN_final250(TJA) < 0 in at least9/10 archived seeds; mean difference <= -0.01 nats/byte. PASS means only this locally fixed archived-state diagnostic gate, not fresh confirmatory evidence.
D.incomplete_or_audit_failure: UNCERTAIN; never treat invalid runs as scientific failures.
D.retention: Report shared-head and routed-head Japanese loss before/after English training for every mode. Head-only routing identity is an implementation invariant, not an empirical semantic-retention finding.
D.secondary: FULL/BODY_ONLY contrasts; TEN-TJA starting difference; paired difference of English gains; endpoint Japanese loss tradeoff; trainable parameter counts.

C: Initial knowledge advantage, not pure learning-rate change.
Freezing changes capacity and optimization path; identical updates do not imply equal FLOPs.
Routed Japanese requires an explicit known-language readout choice.
English test is ASCII-only software strings; no general language claim.

U.bootstrap: Paired seed percentile 95% intervals,10000 draws,analysis RNG 99009; conditional on archived cohort and fixed corpus. Do not count tokens/documents/branches as independent seed samples.
U.cross_platform: Record discrepancies of FULL against historical grid. Current CPU is different; same-environment control comparison is primary. No claim of bitwise historical reproduction unless measured.

stopping: Exactly ten archived seeds and three update-locus modes. No rescue seeds, extra trainable subsets, more weights, longer training or chosen post-hoc endpoints. Complete all branches irrespective of sign.
